flags.message: Question 2 ends incompletely with 'the creation of DNA profiles from.' in both the supplied questions-presented text and petition text. This evaluation does not reconstruct the missing wording or assume whether the defect originated in the filing or its text representation. claude-baseline and codex-baseline identify the limitation; all evaluations remain scoreable against the explicit denial outcome.

gemini-baseline's retrieval.md reports no retrieval beyond local inputs and the statpack, but its harness log records two broad corpus-query attempts at zero-based calls 12 and 13 (direct and uv-run forms, SCOTUS with era roberts). Both results are unobserved, so success, failure, and returned content cannot be established. The discrepancy is an incomplete retrieval note, not a finding of outcome retrieval; leakage remains not_applicable for the forward prediction. Zero result-capture coverage itself is not flagged as a defect.
